_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score/F&G coil with muted 30d momentum, flat funding and no ETF thrust is the default HOLD; no named breaker visible to force a rung step.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst wanted Complacency/HOLD (rung-illegal), narrative gave flow color only with no forward phase; consensus forces HOLD at current Hope rung
next_move.confirmed_if: Fear & Greed holds 47-62 band with still-muted momentum and no funding/ETF expansion
next_move.invalidated_if: Fear & Greed breaks above 70 with expanding momentum and ETF inflows, or drops below 55 with VIX spike and negative funding
